title: Polynomial charts of a coordinate-subspace blowup and smooth etale sources
statement:
Let $R$ be any commutative ring, $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$, $a,b\geq0$, $A=R[x_1,\ldots,x_a,y_1,\ldots,y_b]$ and $J=(y_1,\ldots,y_b)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Let $M=\operatorname{Bl}_J(\operatorname{Spec}A)$ with its structural map to $S$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. If $b>0$, the standard affine blowup charts $M_i=\operatorname{Spec}(A[J/y_i])$, $1\leq i\leq b$, cover $M$, and for each $i$ the $R$-algebra homomorphism
$$R[x_1,\ldots,x_a,z,t_j\ (1\leq j\leq b,\ j\ne i)]\longrightarrow A[J/y_i],\qquad x_r\longmapsto x_r,\quad z\longmapsto y_i,\quad t_j\longmapsto y_j/y_i$$
is an isomorphism [def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring]. Thus each $M_i$ is isomorphic over $S$ to $\mathbf A^{a+b}_S$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. If $b=0$, then $J=0$ and $M=\varnothing$. In all cases, for every scheme $W$ and etale morphism $e:W\to M$, the composite $W\to M\to S$ is smooth [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. No reducedness, Noetherian, nonzero-ring or characteristic hypothesis on $R$ is assumed.

proof.text: Assume $b>0$. Apply [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart-cover] to $J=(y_1,\ldots,y_b)$. It gives precisely the open cover $M_i=\operatorname{Spec}(A[J/y_i])$, indexed by $1\leq i\leq b$.

source.place: Tag 0804, lemma-blowing-up-affine; finite generating family version

proof.text:
Fix $i$ and put $P_i=R[x_1,\ldots,x_a,z,t_j\ (j
e i)]$. By the polynomial universal property [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] the displayed assignments define an $R$-algebra map $\phi_i:P_i	o A[J/y_i]$. The chart definition [def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring] realizes its target inside $A_{y_i}$. Its image contains the image of $A$: besides $x_r$ and $y_i$, it contains every $y_j=y_i(y_j/y_i)=\phi_i(zt_j)$ for $j
e i$. Every $h\in J$ is $\sum_j a_jy_j$, so $h/y_i=a_i+\sum_{j
e i}a_j(y_j/y_i)$ is also in the image. Thus the image contains all the algebra generators in the chart definition, proving surjectivity.

source.place: Tag 0H1H, remark-relative-blowup, final polynomial chart identification; explicit generator calculation

proof.text:
For injectivity expand $F\in P_i$ as $\sum_{\alpha,m, eta}c_{\alpha,m, eta}x^\alpha z^m t^ eta$ using [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], with $ eta$ indexed by $j
e i$. Choose $N\geq\sum_{j
e i} eta_j$ for every term. In $A_{y_i}$, the element $y_i^N\phi_i(F)$ is the image of $G=\sum c_{\alpha,m, eta}x^\alpha y_i^{N+m-\sum_j eta_j}\prod_{j
e i}y_j^{ eta_j}\in A$. If $\phi_i(F)=0$, the fraction equality in [def-weil-ring-localization-away] gives $y_i^KG=0$ in $A$ for some $K\geq0$. Distinct triples $(\alpha,m, eta)$ give distinct monomials in $y_i^KG$: their exponents on $x_r$ and $y_j$ ($j
e i$) recover $\alpha, eta$, and the exponent on $y_i$ then recovers $m$. Polynomial coefficient uniqueness therefore gives every $c_{\alpha,m, eta}=0$. Hence $F=0$. This argument uses no cancellation in $R$ and works also when $R=0$.

source.place: Tag 0H1H, remark-relative-blowup, final polynomial chart identification; explicit coefficient argument filling the omitted calculation

proof.text: The preceding bijective $R$-algebra map is an isomorphism. By [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart] the chart $M_i$ of step 1 is identified with $\operatorname{Spec}(A[J/y_i])$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$, so its structural map to $S$ is $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the composite $R\to A\to A[J/y_i]$. Contravariant functoriality of affine spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum] gives $M_i\simeq\operatorname{Spec}P_i$ over $S$, because the algebra isomorphism commutes with the inclusions of $R$. There are $a+1+(b-1)=a+b$ variables. The affine-base description of [def-sbc-affine-space] identifies $\operatorname{Spec}P_i$ with $\mathbf A^{a+b}_S$.

source.place: Tag 0H1H, remark-relative-blowup, last identification of D_+(T_i)

proof.text: If $b=0$, the ideal $J=0$ has the one-element generating family $(0)$. By [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart-cover], $M$ is covered by the single chart $\operatorname{Spec}(A[0/0])$. The localization $A_0$ is the zero ring: its inverted element $0$ is a unit, so $0=1$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Its chart subalgebra [def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring] is consequently the zero ring. Its spectrum has no prime ideals [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; thus the covering chart and $M$ are empty.

source.place: Tag 0804, lemma-blowing-up-affine, specialized to the zero ideal and its generator 0

proof.text: For $b>0$, [sbc-lem-affine-space-smooth] makes $\mathbf A^{a+b}_S\to S$ smooth. The isomorphisms over $S$ from step 4 and isomorphism invariance in [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-restrict-open-subschemes](c) make every $M_i\to S$ smooth. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-local-on-source] to the cover in step 1 to obtain smoothness of $M\to S$. For $b=0$, apply the same lemma to the empty open cover of $M=\varnothing$; its hypotheses are vacuous. Now let $e:W\to M$ be any etale morphism. It is smooth by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-smooth-zero-dimensional-fibres], and [lem-trf-smooth-composition] makes $W\to M\to S$ smooth. None of these statements requires a finiteness or reducedness assumption on $R$, or any quasi-compactness assumption on $e$.
